```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(arrow)
library(collapse)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
iucn_lookup <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nceas-range-shifts/chi_shifts/ab9cd09931a4ce5c12d0bcd2984595d6522ed158/_data/iucn_redlist_2026/iucn_worms_aphia_id_complete.csv")
```

```{r}
iucn_new_cat <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nceas-range-shifts/chi_shifts/refs/heads/main/_data/iucn_redlist_2026/iucn_species_assessments.csv")
```

```{r}
# Load functions for processing AquaX data
source(here( "common_fxns.R"))
```

```{r}
library(rnaturalearth)
globe <- ne_countries(scale = "large", returnclass = "sf")
```

## Prep AquaX data

```{r}
# read in meta data on the aquax species
load("/home/shares/data-aquax/META_02122025.Rdata")
```

```{r}
meta_clean <- META %>% 
  mutate(worms_name = tolower(ScientificName)) %>% 
  select(!ScientificName) %>% 
  # simplify for now for easier viewing
  select(AphiaID, SPID, worms_name, GROUP, NR_CR, range_pixels, SDM)
```

```{r}
spp_fs <- list.files('/home/shares/data-aquax/SDM',
                     full.names = TRUE)

df <- data.frame(f = spp_fs) %>%
    mutate(fsize = file.size(f),
           aphiaid = str_extract(basename(f), '[0-9]+') %>% as.integer()) %>%
    left_join(META, by = c('aphiaid' = 'AphiaID'))
```

## Read in iconic species
Starting with the Baltic Sea and British Columbia
```{r}
bhi_ico_spp <- read_csv(here("data/sp_ico_assessments_bhi2019.csv"))
```

```{r}
bhi_ico_spp_clean <- bhi_ico_spp %>% 
  #mutate(scientific_name_clean = str_trim(str_remove(scientific_name, "\\(.*$")))
  mutate(scientific_name_clean = word(scientific_name, 1, 2))
```


```{r}
# Get list of iconic species in the baltic health index (bhi)
bhi_ico_spp_list <- tolower(unique(bhi_ico_spp_clean$scientific_name_clean))
```

```{r}
# Filter iucn lookup for iconic species (the two birds are not in AquaX)
bhi_ico_lookup <- iucn_lookup %>% filter(iucn_sciname %in% bhi_ico_spp_list)
```

```{r}
bhi_ico_lookup_aquax <- bhi_ico_lookup %>% 
  filter(aquax == "SDM")

bhi_aquax_aphiaid <- bhi_ico_lookup_aquax$aphia_id
```

```{r}
# Filter df for baltic iconic species
df_bhi <- df  %>% 
  filter(aphiaid %in% bhi_aquax_aphiaid)
```


 ## Find species change
 
```{r}
system.time({
  bhi_spp_exit_pxl_count_df <- parallel::mclapply(bhi_aquax_aphiaid, FUN = extract_all_exit_pixels_df_db, 
                                       df = df_bhi, 
                                       s = "RCP45_2050",
                                       mc.cores = 2)
})
```


```{r}
bhi_exit_rcp45_df <- bind_rows(bhi_spp_exit_pxl_count_df) %>% 
  filter(exit == 1)
```

```{r}
# Sum by XY cell, using collapse
system.time({
bhi_exit_rcp45_sum_df <- bhi_exit_rcp45_df %>% 
  fgroup_by(x, y) %>% 
  fcount() %>% 
  mutate(scenario = "RCP45_2050") %>% 
  rename(n_exit_pxls = N)
})
```

```{r}
baltic_exit <- ggplot() +
  #geom_sf(data = eez_simple_sf, fill = "#f4f4f4", color = NA) +
  #geom_sf(data = eez_contested_sf, fill = "#f4f4f4", color = NA) +
  geom_tile(data = bhi_exit_rcp45_sum_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = n_exit_pxls)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(53.5, 66), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, 29), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "rocket",
direction = 1,
                      limits = c(1, 9),
                      trans = "sqrt",
                      breaks = c(1, 3, 6, 9),
                      guide = guide_colorbar(
                      #barwidth  = unit(5, "cm"),   # wide bar for bottom placement
                      #barheight = unit(0.4, "cm"),
                      ticks = TRUE,
                      ticks.colour = "white",
                      ticks.linewidth = 0.8
  )) +
  #geom_sf(data = eez_simple_sf, color = "gray", size = 0.2, fill = "NA") +
  #geom_sf(data = eez_contested_sf, color = "red", size = 0.2, fill = "NA") +
  geom_sf(data = globe, fill = "cornsilk2", size = 0.1, color = "black")+
  labs(title = "Baltic Sea",
       fill = "loss species count", 
       x = "",
       y = "") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.margin = margin(l = 5)) 
```

```{r}
# Run Baltic Sea current species (don't need parallel)

                                       FUN = species_count,

                                       s = "Current",
                                       n_threads = 1)
})
```


## British Columbia 

## Read in BC OHI regions

```{r}
bc_region <- read_sf(here("data/ohibc_rgn/ohibc_rgn.dbf"))
```

```{r}
# set crs to WGS84
bc_region_wgs84 <- bc_region %>% 
  st_transform(crs = 4326)
```

## Read in iconic species
Starting with the Baltic Sea and British Columbia
```{r}
bc_ico_spp <- read_csv(here("data/ohibc_ico_spp_trend.csv"))
```

```{r}
bc_ico_spp_clean <- bc_ico_spp %>% 
  mutate(sciname_clean = word(sciname, 1, 2))
```


```{r}
# Get list of iconic species british columbia
bc_ico_spp_list <- tolower(unique(bc_ico_spp_clean$sciname_clean))
```

```{r}
# Filter iucn lookup for iconic species - double check filtered to 39 instead of 42
# No ammodytes hexapterus which is aphiaid 254510 (has SDM)
# No haliotis kamtschatkana which is aphiaid 405014 (has SDM)
# No canada goose
bc_ico_lookup <- iucn_lookup %>% filter(iucn_sciname %in% bc_ico_spp_list)
```

```{r}
bc_ico_lookup_aquax <- bc_ico_lookup %>% 
  filter(aquax == "SDM")

bc_aquax_aphiaid <- bc_ico_lookup_aquax$aphia_id

# Add the two missing species from above (weren't in iucn lookup)
bc_aquax_aphiaid <- c(bc_aquax_aphiaid, 254510, 405014)
```

```{r}
# Filter df for BC iconic species
df_bc <- df  %>% 
  filter(aphiaid %in% bc_aquax_aphiaid)
```


## Find species change
 
```{r}
system.time({
  bc_spp_exit_pxl_count_df <- parallel::mclapply(bc_aquax_aphiaid, FUN = extract_all_exit_pixels_df_db, 
                                       df = df_bc, 
                                       s = "RCP45_2050",
                                       mc.cores = 2)
})
```


```{r}
bc_exit_rcp45_df <- bind_rows(bc_spp_exit_pxl_count_df) %>% 
  filter(exit == 1)
```

```{r}
# Sum by XY cell, using collapse
system.time({
bc_exit_rcp45_sum_df <- bc_exit_rcp45_df %>% 
  fgroup_by(x, y) %>% 
  fcount() %>% 
  mutate(scenario = "RCP45_2050") %>% 
  rename(n_exit_pxls = N)
})
```

```{r}
bc_exit <- ggplot() +
  #geom_sf(data = eez_simple_sf, fill = "#f4f4f4", color = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = bc_region_wgs84, fill = "#f4f4f4", color = NA) +
  geom_tile(data = bc_exit_rcp45_sum_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = n_exit_pxls)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(46, 56), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-139, -122), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "rocket",
direction = 1,
                      limits = c(1, 35),
                      trans = "sqrt",
                      breaks = c(1, 5, 15, 35),
                      guide = guide_colorbar(
                      #barwidth  = unit(5, "cm"),   # wide bar for bottom placement
                      #barheight = unit(0.4, "cm"),
                      ticks = TRUE,
                      ticks.colour = "white",
                      ticks.linewidth = 0.8
  )) +
  #geom_sf(data = eez_simple_sf, color = "gray", size = 0.2, fill = "NA") +
  #geom_sf(data = eez_contested_sf, color = "red", size = 0.2, fill = "NA") +
  geom_sf(data = bc_region_wgs84, fill = NA, color = "gray") +
  geom_sf(data = globe, fill = "cornsilk2", size = 0.1, color = "black")+
  labs(title = "British Columbia",
       fill = "loss species count", 
       x = "",
       y = "") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.margin = margin(l = 5)) 
```

```{r}
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(46, 56), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-139, -122), expand = c(0, 0)) +
```
```{r}
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako",
direction = 1,
                      limits = c(1, 35),
                      trans = "sqrt",
                      breaks = c(1, 5, 15, 35),
                      guide = guide_colorbar(

                      #barheight = unit(0.4, "cm"),
                      ticks = TRUE,
                      ticks.colour = "white",

  geom_sf(data = bc_region_wgs84, fill = NA, color = "gray") +
  geom_sf(data = globe, fill = "cornsilk2", size = 0.1, color = "black")+
  labs(title = "British Columbia",
       fill = "new species count", 
       x = "",
       y = "") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.margin = margin(l = 5))
```

## Northeast (Gulf of Maine)

```{r}
# Read in iconic species data
ne_ico <- read_csv(here("data/iconic_species_ne_list.csv"))
```

```{r}
ne_ico_clean <- ne_ico %>% 
  # Adjust scientific name of Atlantic Sturgeon to match iucn_lookup
  mutate(scientific = ifelse(scientific == "Acipenser oxyrhynchus oxyrhynchus", "Acipenser oxyrinchus", scientific))
```


```{r}
# Get list of northeast iconic species 
ne_ico_spp_list <- tolower(unique(ne_ico_clean$scientific))
```

```{r}
# Filter iucn lookup for iconic species
# No invertabrates
# No bay scallop Argopecten irradians 156817
# No blue crab Callinectes sapidus 107379
# No american oyster Crossostrea virginia
# No Northern quahog Mecenaria mercenaria
# No soft shell clam Mya arenaria
# No atlantic surfclam Spissula solidissima
ne_ico_lookup <- iucn_lookup %>% filter(iucn_sciname %in% ne_ico_spp_list)
```

```{r}
ne_ico_lookup_aquax <- ne_ico_lookup %>% 
  filter(aquax == "SDM")

ne_aquax_aphiaid <- ne_ico_lookup_aquax$aphia_id

# Add the two missing species from above (weren't in iucn lookup)
ne_aquax_aphiaid <- c(ne_aquax_aphiaid, 156817, 107379)
```

```{r}
# Filter df for NE iconic species
df_ne <- df  %>% 
  filter(aphiaid %in% ne_aquax_aphiaid)
```

## Read in NE OHI regions

```{r}
ne_region <- read_sf(here("data/ne_rgn/ne_ohi_rgns.dbf"))
```

```{r}
# set crs to WGS84
ne_region_wgs84 <- ne_region %>% 
  st_transform(crs = 4326)
```

## Gulf of California

```{r}
# Read in species 
goc_ico <- read_csv(here("data/ico_spp_goc_sept26.csv"))

```
```{r}
# Drop mobula species line since the five species in Mexico will be added by aphiaid later
goc_ico_clean <- goc_ico %>% 
  filter(sci_name != "Mobula spp.") %>% 
  # drop hammerhead species (seems like scalloped and smooth are found in GOC)
  filter(sci_name != "Sphyrna spp.") %>% 
  #drop plants
  filter(general_group != "flora")
```

```{r}
# Get list of northeast iconic species 
goc_ico_spp_list <- tolower(unique(goc_ico_clean$sci_name))
```

```{r}
# Filter iucn lookup for iconic species
# no Chelonia agassizi (regional subspecies of Chelonia mydas)
# no Delphinus capensis (regional subspecies of Delphius delphis)
# no Heermann's Gull Larus heermani
# no Thalasseus elegans elenant tern
# no osprey
# no Penaeus stylirostris (blue shrimp)
# no Megapitaria squalida 714777 chocolate clam
# no Pinctada mazatlanica 464493
# no Pinna rugosa 507084
# no Pteria sterna 464505
goc_ico_lookup <- iucn_lookup %>% filter(iucn_sciname %in% goc_ico_spp_list)
```

```{r}
goc_ico_lookup_aquax <- goc_ico_lookup %>% 
  filter(aquax == "SDM")

goc_aquax_aphiaid <- goc_ico_lookup_aquax$aphia_id

# Add the two missing species from above (weren't in iucn lookup)
goc_aquax_aphiaid <- c(goc_aquax_aphiaid, 714777, 464493, 507084, 464505,
                       # hammerheads
                       105819, 105816,
                       # rays
                       1026118, 105859, 105858, 217430, 271482)
```

```{r}
# Filter df for GOC iconic species (the six birds drop out)
df_goc <- df  %>% 
  filter(aphiaid %in% goc_aquax_aphiaid)
```

## Find species change
 
```{r}
system.time({
  goc_spp_exit_pxl_count_df <- parallel::mclapply(goc_aquax_aphiaid, FUN = extract_all_exit_pixels_df_db,

                                       s = "RCP45_2050",
                                       mc.cores = 2)
})
```

```{r}
  #geom_sf(data = eez_contested_sf, color = "red", size = 0.2, fill = "NA") +
  geom_sf(data = globe, fill = "cornsilk2", size = 0.1, color = "black")+
  labs(title = "Gulf of California",
       fill = "loss species count", 
       x = "",
       y = "") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.margin = margin(l = 5))
```

```{r}

  fgroup_by(x, y) %>% 
  fcount() %>% 
  mutate(scenario = "RCP45_2050") %>% 
  rename(n_entry_pxls = N)
})
```
